title: Backup push docs: align the brief's push steps and the deadline wording with the shipped behaviour
outcome: Backup push docs: align the brief's push steps and the deadline wording with the shipped behaviour
acceptance: docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md and docs/shipped.md say that a transport deadline leaves an attempt pending only when it passes during the resolution of a pending attempt or the put, and that a deadline passed while confirming the newest copy of an unchanged store keeps the existing receipt and creates no pending attempt

docs/features/off-host-backup.md's Push section states that retention runs after the attempt is recorded, and that a retention removal past the transport deadline is a warning that keeps the push's own exit code
